supplements.title: Dual in vitro and in silico evaluation of the apoptosis-inducing and migration-inhibiting potential of Capparis spinosa methanol extract in prostate cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Capparis spinosa plant extract triggers cell death and stops movement in prostate cancer cells through flavonoid compounds.

supplements.title: Unraveling the therapeutic potential of Elaeagnus angustifolia extract on triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): An investigation using zebrafish model.
supplements.summary: Elaeagnus angustifolia extract safely reduced triple-negative breast cancer cell growth in zebrafish, warranting further investigation as a potential treatment.

supplements.title: Tu-Si-Zi-Wan reduces D-galactose-induced hepatic and cerebral oxidative damage in aging mice via the Nrf2/ARE pathway.
supplements.summary: Tu-Si-Zi-Wan, a traditional Chinese formula, reduces aging-related liver and brain damage in mice by activating antioxidant protective pathways.

supplements.title: A Self-Propelled Molecular Rocket Triggers Ferroptosis and Apoptosis for Improving Herceptin Resistance in Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a self-propelled molecular rocket that overcomes Herceptin resistance in breast cancer by triggering cell death through ferroptosis and apoptosis.

supplements.title: Therapeutic efficacy of Curcuma longa leaf extract in experimental models of arthritis.
supplements.summary: Turmeric leaf extract reduced arthritis symptoms in rats by targeting inflammation and pain pathways, offering potential as a complementary treatment.

supplements.title: Citronellol potentiates sunitinib efficacy in renal cell carcinoma by targeting JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Citronellol, a plant compound, enhances the kidney cancer drug sunitinib by blocking JAK2/STAT3 survival signals.

supplements.title: CALR/HIF-1α Positive Feedback Loop Drives CALR Upregulation to Promote EMT-Mediated Bladder Cancer Progression via ROS/AKT Axis.
supplements.summary: CALR protein drives bladder cancer progression through a feedback loop with HIF-1α, and the compound Sinapine effectively blocks this process in tests.

supplements.title: Mechanism and experimental validation of a network pharmacology-based approach of Huoluo Yinao formula in treating chronic cerebral hypoperfusion.
supplements.summary: Traditional Chinese formula HLYN improves brain blood flow and cognitive function in rats by reducing inflammation and oxidative stress through HSP90AA1 inhibition.

supplements.title: Inhibitory effect of blestriarene C on triple-negative breast cancer: Inducing ferroptosis and mitophagy via SESN2/AKT/FOXO4 axis.
supplements.summary: Blestriarene C, a novel compound, kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by triggering two cellular death mechanisms through a specific protein pathway.

supplements.title: The impact of gut microbiota modulation on responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer.
supplements.summary: Specific gut bacteria improve cancer immunotherapy response and survival, while antibiotics harm outcomes in immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment.

supplements.title: Moderate-to-vigorous Physical Activity and Total and Site-specific Cancer: The Japan Public Health Center-based Prospective Study.
supplements.summary: Moderate-to-vigorous physical activity is associated with lower overall cancer risk across multiple cancer types in Japanese adults.

supplements.title: Flavokawain C suppresses nephroblastoma growth by inducing autophagy-mediated downregulation of FABP4 via AMPK/mTOR pathway.
supplements.summary: Flavokawain C suppresses pediatric kidney cancer (nephroblastoma) growth by activating a cellular cleanup process that destroys a cancer-promoting protein.

supplements.title: Intralesional Therapies For Cutaneous Viral Warts: A Comparative Analysis Of Vitamin D3 And Acyclovir
supplements.summary: Study compares intralesional vitamin D3 and acyclovir injections for clearing cutaneous warts in patients aged 12 and older.

supplements.title: BfedBwell INSPIRE: Impact of an Integrated Nutrition and Exercise Program for Post-treatment Survivors on Sleep Quality, Perceived Stress, and Biomarkers of Immune Dysregulation
supplements.summary: A pilot study tests whether combined nutrition and exercise programs improve sleep, stress, and immune health in cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Current landscape and therapeutic prospects of indole hybrids for prostate cancer treatment: A mini-review.
supplements.summary: Indole hybrid compounds show promise for treating prostate cancer by targeting multiple pathways and overcoming drug resistance.

off_label.title: Glutamine antagonist DON attenuates chikungunya virus-induced myositis by suppressing inflammatory activation in a murine model.
off_label.summary: DON, a glutamine inhibitor, reduces chikungunya virus-induced muscle inflammation by suppressing immune cell activation, without affecting viral control.

off_label.title: The dual role of the crosstalk between autophagy and ferroptosis in lung cancer treatment: Advances in mechanisms and therapeutic strategies (Review).
off_label.summary: Researchers found that combining autophagy and ferroptosis processes offers dual benefits for treating lung cancer through various drug combination strategies.

off_label.title: Propofol regulates METTL3-mediated PARP-1 m6A modification to promote Parthanatos to improve NSCLC chemotherapy resistance.
off_label.summary: Propofol enhances lung cancer chemotherapy by activating a cell death pathway through modification of the PARP-1 protein.

off_label.title: A glucocorticoid-FAS axis controls immune evasion during metastatic seeding.
off_label.summary: Blocking glucocorticoid receptors in metastatic breast cancer cells restores immune attack and reduces tumor spread in mice.

off_label.title: Fertility-preserving treatment of endometrial cancer and endometrial atypical hyperplasia for patients with metabolic abnormalities: Challenge or opportunity?
off_label.summary: Researchers tested combining hormone-blocking therapy with metabolic treatments to preserve fertility in young women with early-stage endometrial cancer.

off_label.title: Comparison of Antiplatelets and Anticoagulants for Secondary Stroke Prevention in Ischemic Stroke Patients with Cancer: A Meta-Analysis.
off_label.summary: In cancer patients with stroke, antiplatelet drugs and anticoagulants equally prevent recurrent strokes, but antiplatelets reduce death risk more.

off_label.title: MondoA mediates transcriptional coordination between the MYC network and the integrated stress response in pancreatic cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking MondoA protein kills pancreatic cancer cells with high MYC levels by disrupting stress response pathways and triggering cell death.

off_label.title: Finerenone in Type 1 Diabetes and Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: Researchers are testing whether finerenone, a kidney-protective drug, works safely and effectively for type 1 diabetes patients with kidney disease.

off_label.title: Ion-Exchange and Energy-Stress Strategies Amplified Dual-Site Nanozyme-Mediated Ferroptosis/Pyroptosis Inhibition for Neuroprotection.
off_label.summary: Researchers developed a nano-particle treatment that crosses the brain barrier to prevent cell death and reduce inflammation after brain hemorrhage.

off_label.title: Immunotherapy Inhibits Tumor Cholesterol Synthesis via the IFNγ-IRF1-SREBF2 Axis.
off_label.summary: Immunotherapy blocks cholesterol production in cancer cells through an immune signaling pathway, slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Promiscuously bioactive compounds are prevalent in widely used commercial drug repurposing libraries.
off_label.summary: Drug repurposing libraries contain many promiscuous compounds that may lead researchers astray and waste resources on ineffective clinical trials.

off_label.title: Imeglimin Exerts Anti-Tumor Activity in Multiple Myeloma Through Affecting Energy Metabolism and Downregulating IL-16 Expression.
off_label.summary: Imeglimin, an anti-diabetic drug, slows multiple myeloma growth by disrupting cancer cell energy and reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: Cardioprotective effects of prophylactic ACE inhibitors in anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials.
off_label.summary: ACE inhibitors help prevent heart damage in cancer patients receiving anthracycline chemotherapy, particularly those also taking trastuzumab.

off_label.title: Targeting the RXR Pathway for the Prevention of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
off_label.summary: RXR agonist drugs delayed or prevented triple-negative breast cancer development in mouse models with minimal side effects.

off_label.title: The multifunctional RNA helicase DDX39A drives glioblastoma progression by modulating WISP1 alternative splicing that induces an immunosuppressive macrophage polarization.
off_label.summary: DDX39A protein drives glioblastoma growth by suppressing immune cells; blocking it with a drug slows tumor progression.

biomarkers.title: An exploratory serum metabolomics study for screening and staging of breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified unique metabolic patterns in blood serum that could help detect and classify breast cancer stages.

biomarkers.title: PD-1 genetic fate mapping uncovers immune cell diversity mediating the efficacy of combined PD-1 blockade and chemotherapy.
biomarkers.summary: Combining chemotherapy with PD-1 blockade expands cancer-fighting immune cells in lung tumors, revealing how the treatment works.

biomarkers.title: Glutamine antagonist DON attenuates chikungunya virus-induced myositis by suppressing inflammatory activation in a murine model.
biomarkers.summary: DON, a glutamine inhibitor, reduces chikungunya virus-induced muscle inflammation by suppressing immune cell activation, without affecting viral control.

biomarkers.title: TimeVault turns vault particles into molecular memory of transcriptional states: how to decode the cellular black box.
biomarkers.summary: TimeVault stores cell gene expression histories inside living cells, revealing which cancer cells will survive drug treatment before therapy begins.

biomarkers.title: Advances in the application of frailty scoring in the diagnosis and management of elderly patients with multiple myeloma (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Frailty scoring helps doctors better diagnose and personalize treatment for elderly multiple myeloma patients, improving safety and outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Knockdown of CCT2 inhibits the malignant progression of hepatocellular carcinoma cells by impairing STAT3 activation.
biomarkers.summary: Reducing CCT2 protein slows hepatocellular carcinoma growth by blocking STAT3 activation, suggesting CCT2 as a treatment target.

biomarkers.title: Cellular and inflammatory characteristics of patient‑derived glioblastoma organoids during in vitro cultivation.
biomarkers.summary: Patient-derived glioblastoma organoids maintain tumor characteristics for 7-14 days, providing an optimal window for preclinical research models.

biomarkers.title: Exosomal circ0000549 promotes MNNG‑induced gastric cancer through miR‑15b‑5p/KIF1B.
biomarkers.summary: Exosomal circ0000549 promotes gastric cancer development in nitrite-exposed cells by blocking miR-15b-5p, offering a potential diagnostic biomarker.

biomarkers.title: ACSBG1‑driven lipid reprogramming unveiled: A fatty acid metabolism‑associated prognostic model for lung adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified ACSBG1 as a protective gene in lung cancer that suppresses tumor growth and boosts immune response, offering a new prognostic tool.

biomarkers.title: Mechanistic insights into inflammatory cytokines in adenomyosis‑induced infertility (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Inflammatory proteins disrupting the uterus prevent embryo implantation in adenomyosis; targeting these proteins could restore fertility.

biomarkers.title: The dual role of the crosstalk between autophagy and ferroptosis in lung cancer treatment: Advances in mechanisms and therapeutic strategies (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found that combining autophagy and ferroptosis processes offers dual benefits for treating lung cancer through various drug combination strategies.

biomarkers.title: FOXM1 inhibitor, RCM‑1, enhances venetoclax mediated apoptosis through downregulation of ATP2B4 in rhabdomyosarcoma.
biomarkers.summary: A combination of FOXM1 inhibitor RCM-1 and venetoclax kills rhabdomyosarcoma cells by reducing a calcium channel protein called ATP2B4.

biomarkers.title: Pancreatic cancer EMT‑targeted therapy: Molecular mechanisms and clinical translation (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Targeting EMT, a key driver of pancreatic cancer spread and drug resistance, offers promising new treatment strategies to improve survival.

biomarkers.title: RNA‑binding protein DAZAP1 promotes gastric cancer metastasis by enhancing NOTCH1 and JAG1 mRNA stability.
biomarkers.summary: DAZAP1 protein promotes gastric cancer spread by stabilizing NOTCH1 and JAG1 messenger molecules.

biomarkers.title: Characteristics of chromosomal instability‑related lncRNAs associated with progression and prognosis in breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified 12 chromosomal instability-related genes that predict breast cancer survival and found U62317.4 promotes cancer cell growth.

trials.title: PD-1 genetic fate mapping uncovers immune cell diversity mediating the efficacy of combined PD-1 blockade and chemotherapy.
trials.summary: Combining chemotherapy with PD-1 blockade expands cancer-fighting immune cells in lung tumors, revealing how the treatment works.

trials.title: Advances in the application of frailty scoring in the diagnosis and management of elderly patients with multiple myeloma (Review).
trials.summary: Frailty scoring helps doctors better diagnose and personalize treatment for elderly multiple myeloma patients, improving safety and outcomes.

trials.title: FOXM1 inhibitor, RCM‑1, enhances venetoclax mediated apoptosis through downregulation of ATP2B4 in rhabdomyosarcoma.
trials.summary: A combination of FOXM1 inhibitor RCM-1 and venetoclax kills rhabdomyosarcoma cells by reducing a calcium channel protein called ATP2B4.

trials.title: Pancreatic cancer EMT‑targeted therapy: Molecular mechanisms and clinical translation (Review).
trials.summary: Targeting EMT, a key driver of pancreatic cancer spread and drug resistance, offers promising new treatment strategies to improve survival.

trials.title: Advances in immunotherapy and targeted therapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma: Current progress and combined approaches (Review).
trials.summary: Combined immunotherapy and targeted therapy show promise for treating nasopharyngeal carcinoma, with emerging approaches like bispecific antibodies offering new possibilities.

trials.title: Mechanisms of chemoresistance in diffuse large B‑cell lymphoma and novel therapeutic strategies (Review).
trials.summary: Researchers identified multiple mechanisms of drug resistance in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and explored new treatments to overcome them.

trials.title: Multimodal treatment with thiotepa, bevacizumab, teniposide, and tunlametinib in a patient with neurofibromatosis type 1-associated oligodendroglioma: a rare case report.
trials.summary: A four-drug combination including MEK inhibitor tunlametinib achieved complete tumor response in a rare NF1-associated oligodendroglioma patient.

trials.title: Locoregional and symptomatic response to neoadjuvant dual HER2 blockade with chemotherapy in HER2-positive breast cancer: a pilot study.
trials.summary: Dual HER2 blockade with chemotherapy before surgery shrinks HER2-positive breast tumors and improves symptoms in most patients.

trials.title: Development of a Classifier for Metabolic Subtypes of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma to Guide Personalized Immunotherapy Strategies: Biomarker Analysis of the Phase III CONTINUUM and DIPPER Trials.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a metabolic biomarker test to predict which nasopharyngeal cancer patients will benefit most from immunotherapy treatment.

trials.title: Clinical Impact and Clinicopathologic Correlations of Oncotype DX in Hormone Receptor-Positive/HER2-Negative Early Breast Cancer: Real-World Evidence From a Large Brazilian Cohort (GBECAM 0520).
trials.summary: Oncotype DX testing helps Brazilian breast cancer patients avoid unnecessary chemotherapy by predicting which hormone receptor-positive tumors truly need it.

trials.title: Molecular and Antiangiogenic Effects of Paclitaxel-Loaded Nanoparticles: Influence of the Nanocarrier Type.
trials.summary: Nanoparticle-encapsulated paclitaxel effectively treats breast cancer while reducing toxicity and enhancing drug-induced DNA damage compared to standard drug delivery.

trials.title: Modulating AP-1 enables CAR T cells to establish an intratumoral stemlike reservoir and overcomes resistance to PD-1 blockade.
trials.summary: Boosting a protein called c-Jun in CAR T cells enables them to work better with PD-1 blockade immunotherapy in lung cancer.

trials.title: The effect of neoadjuvant therapy on radiological, surgical, and pathological results in nonmetastatic breast cancer: A retrospective observational study.
trials.summary: Neoadjuvant therapy improves breast cancer tumor shrinkage, enabling more patients to qualify for breast-conserving surgery.

trials.title: Serum inflammatory factors as predictors of severity and prognosis in heart failure: A cohort study.
trials.summary: Three inflammatory markers—IL-2 receptor, IL-6, and IL-1β—predict heart failure severity and one-year survival outcomes.

trials.title: Predictive value of high-resolution computed tomography radiomics for assessing the invasiveness of pulmonary adenocarcinoma presenting as ground-glass nodules: A retrospective study.
trials.summary: A combined imaging and data analysis model accurately predicts whether lung adenocarcinoma nodules are invasive, improving treatment planning.
